question: There are primarily three pieces of equipment, a bowl, a jack and a mat, which are needed to play _____.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Lawn Bowls**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lawn Bowls** is a game that involves rolling balls on a flat lawn or green towards a smaller target ball called the **jack**.
 
• It is played using a **bowl (biased ball)**, a **jack (target ball)**, and a **mat** (used for placement of the bowl).
 
• The game originated in **England** and is popular in several countries such as **Australia, New Zealand, and Canada**.
 
• Lawn Bowls is a sport that requires precision, strategy, and control over the trajectory of the bowl.
 
• The bowls are **weighted or biased** to allow players to curve their trajectory during play.
 
• The objective is to position the bowl as close as possible to the **jack**, outscoring the opponent.
 
• It is played in various formats such as **singles, pairs, triples, and fours**.
 
• Lawn Bowls is included in the **Commonwealth Games** and is recognized as a competitive international sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Boxing**__

 __
 
• **Boxing** is a combat sport in which two participants throw punches at each other while wearing protective gloves.
 
• It is governed by rules to ensure safety, such as **weight classes** and **time limits.**
 
• Boxing originated from ancient combat techniques and gained prominence in modern sports during the **18th century**.
 
• Prominent boxing events include the **Olympics**, **World Championships**, and professional fights organized by bodies such as the **WBC**, **WBA**, and **IBF**.
 
 
 
• **Table Tennis**__
 __
 
• **Table Tennis**, also known as ping pong, is played using a paddle, a lightweight ball, and a table with a net.
 
• The sport was invented in **England** during the late **19th century** and is now popular worldwide.
 
• It requires quick reflexes, precision, and strategy to outscore the opponent by hitting the ball across the net.
 
• Popular international events include the **World Table Tennis Championships** and the **Olympics**.
 
 
 
• **Fencing**__
 
 
• **Fencing** is a combat sport that involves sword fighting using weapons such as the **foil**, **épée**, and **sabre**.
 
• The sport originated in **Europe** and dates back to the **Middle Ages**.
 
• It is now a major part of the **Olympics**, with athletes competing in individual and team events.
 
• Fencing requires agility, precision, and strategic movements to score points by striking the opponent.
